description.ja: Figure-riseBustの技術をつぎ込んだ決定版！
description.en: The definitive edition that incorporates Figure-riseBust technology!

description.ja: レイヤードインジェクションによる瞳、眉、口の色分けを成形色のみで再現！瞳はグリーンのクリアパーツを採用し、黒目の奥行きを表現！
description.en: Color-coded eyes, eyebrows, and mouth created by layered injection are reproduced using molded colors only! The eyes use green clear parts to express the depth of the black eyes!

description.ja: • レイヤードインジェクションの進化！
表情パーツは1つのパーツで再現！レイヤードインジェクションの最先端技術を採用！
description.en: Facial expression parts are reproduced with one part! Adopts cutting-edge layered injection technology!

description.ja: 原型師こだわりの造形。顔、髪に加え指先や背中など初音ミクの魅力を最大限に追求！
description.en: Sculpted by a master sculptor. In addition to her face and hair, we pursue Hatsune Miku's charm to the fullest, including her fingertips and back!

description.ja: パーツごとに艶やマットの成形品を使い分け、髪、衣装の質感を余すことなく再現！
description.en: Glossy and matte molded parts are used for each part to perfectly reproduce the texture of the hair and costume!
